function.name: bugs.Add
function.description: Add or update an unfixed bug report for a file and symbol. Bug reports must be fixed by a coder agent.

path.description: Relative path to the file that contains the bug, e.g. "./utils/Parse.go"

symbol.description: The symbol affected by the bug, e.g. "Parse" or "structs.Data.Parse".

description.description: One-line description of the bug and the expected fix.

function.name: bugs.Fix
function.description: Mark all bug reports for a file and symbol as fixed.

path.description: Relative path to the file that contained the bug, e.g. "./utils/Parse.go"

symbol.description: The symbol that was fixed, e.g. "Parse" or "structs.Data.Parse".

function.name: bugs.List
function.description: List all currently unfixed bug reports with their file, symbol and description.

function.name: bugs.Search
function.description: Search unfixed bug reports by file path and an optional symbol. Omit symbol to list every bug in the file.

path.description: Relative path to a file or folder, e.g. "./utils/Parse.go"

symbol.description: Optional symbol filter, e.g. "Parse". Omit to list all symbols.
